blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
We present Pow3R-SLAM, a real-time RGB-D simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system that uses Pow3R for tracking and mapping. Inspired by MASt3R-SLAM, a recent work on monocular SLAM using two-view 3D reconstruction priors,
we extend the work to incorporate depth as a prior on the network’s prediction, rather than as geometry to fuse. Where traditional RGB-D SLAM systems struggle with sparsity in the depth images, Pow3R utilizes
the available depth to give a better-conditioned pointmap, while inferring the depths in empty regions from the two-view photometric, depth, and intrinsic data. Evaluated against MASt3R-SLAM following its protocol on 24 sequences from TUM, 7-Scenes, and Replica, Pow3R-SLAM runs 1.6 × \times faster in wall time, has 15 % \% lower mean trajectory error, a 3.1 × \times lower unscaled error, and produces denser maps, with a 30 % \% lower Chamfer distance. We also introduce a hybrid variant that runs 2.1 × \times faster than MASt3R-SLAM at 25.3 frames per second (FPS), while maintaining improved tracking and mapping accuracy. Against ORB-SLAM3 in RGB-D mode, Pow3R-SLAM is more accurate on TUM, 7-Scenes, and ETH3D-SLAM, and completes every TUM sequence. While Pow3R-SLAM can struggle on a small set of self-similar scenes, its overall performance shows that adding depth as a prior for two-view 3D reconstruction SLAM can be beneficial. A project webpage is available at: https://ChrisKolios.github.io/Pow3R-SLAM , and code will be made open-source upon acceptance.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), the problem of mapping a scene while jointly localizing the input sensor relative to the map, is crucial for autonomous robots, augmented reality systems, and self-driving cars, all of which must map and track unknown environments. However, visual SLAM, which relies solely on cameras as input, can fail on visually similar but geometrically distinct scenes, and cannot observe metric scale without a reference. RGB-D SLAM adds a depth sensor so the map and pose can be optimized against both photometric and geometric information.
blocks.zh: 同时进行本地化和绘图(SLAM),一方面对一个场景进行绘图,而另一方面将输入传感器与地图进行本地化,这个问题对于自主机器人,增强现实系统,以及自驾汽车来说都是至关重要的,所有这些车辆都必须绘制地图并跟踪未知的环境. 然而,仅依靠相机作为输入的视觉SLAM可能会在视觉相近但几何相区别的场景上失败,在没有参考的情况下无法观测到测量尺度. RGB-D SLAM增加了一个深度传感器,因此可以对照光度和几何信息来优化地图和姿势.

blocks.en: Classical depth-based SLAM systems such as KinectFusion [ 1 ] and RGB-D systems such as ElasticFusion [ 2 ] treat the depth as geometry, fusing it into the map and tracking against the fused surface. However, real-world depth images are not a perfect representation of the true scene geometry. Depth sensors leave holes on absorptive, dark or shiny surfaces, and are inconsistent at object boundaries (Fig. 1 (c, d)). Systems that fuse these depths as geometry inherit all of these defects, but systems that do not incorporate depth discard a key metric measurement.
blocks.zh: 基于经典深度的SLAM系统,如KinectFusion [1] 和以弹性Fusion [2]等RGB-D系统,将深度视为几何,将深度放入地图并针对被引信的地表进行跟踪. 然而,真实世界的深度图像并不是真实场景几何的完美体现. 深度传感器在吸收物上留下孔口,暗光或闪光地表,在物体边界上不一致(图1(c,d))。 将这些深度作为几何线连接起来的系统继承了所有这些缺陷,但并不包含深度的系统丢弃了关键的计量。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Sensor depth vs. Pow3R output . Given input frames ((a), (b)), with corresponding depth maps ((c), (d)) from the TUM fr1/desk scene [ 3 ] , (e) shows the pointmap result from the back-projected depthmaps, and (f) shows the pointmap result from passing the input RGB-D into Pow3R’s network. Pow3R maintains flat surfaces, and reconstructs the controller where the Kinect sensor lacks the data to do so (fills holes and regularizes surfaces).
blocks.zh: 图1:感光深度对s. Pow3R输出. 给定输入框((a),(b)),并带有TUM fr1/desk场景中相应的深度图((c),(d))[3],(e)显示后期投影深度图的点图结果,(f)显示将输入的RGB-D传入Pow3R网络的点图结果. Pow3R保持平面,并在Kinect传感器缺乏数据的情况下重建控制器(填入孔并规范表面).

blocks.en: Two-view 3D reconstruction prior works, including DUSt3R [ 4 ] , MASt3R [ 5 ] , and Pow3R [ 6 ] have shown that vision transformers (ViTs) can learn the relative geometry of two images. When passing in a pair of images, these networks can output a set of pointmaps in a common frame of reference, from which the relative poses of the cameras that took those images can be recovered. In particular, Pow3R demonstrated that passing depth, camera intrinsics, and relative pose (or any subset thereof) can condition the network, offering more accurate and geometrically consistent surfaces than RGB input alone, and inferring depth where none is provided. In Fig. 1 , the back-projected depth (e) cannot fill in the controller, but Pow3R’s pointmap (f) can.
blocks.zh: 双视三维重建前作,包括DUST3R [4],MAST3R [5],和Pow3R [6]都显示,视变器(ViTs)可以学习出两个图像的相对几何. 当在一对图像中通过时,这些网络可以在共同的参考框中输出出一组点图,从中可以回收取取取出这些图像的相机的相机相对姿势. 尤其是,Pow3R证明了过深、相机内在和相机的相对姿势(或其任何子集)可以给网络带来条件,提供比仅RGB输入更准确和几何一致的地表,并推断不提供深度的地方。 在图1中,后投影深度(e)不能填入控制器,但Pow3R的点图(f)可以填入.

blocks.en: Pow3R-SLAM builds on MASt3R-SLAM [ 7 ] , a monocular system that tracks and maps with MASt3R’s pointmaps, and extends it to a full RGB-D system around Pow3R. Sensor depth enters at three separable sites: conditioning the network’s prediction, fixing the metric scale of every pointmap, and anchoring keyframe geometry inside the global optimization. The map is always the network’s output, so holes are filled and surfaces regularized as in Fig. 1 (f).
blocks.zh: Pow3R-SLAM以MAST3R-SLAM [7]为基础,是一个用MAST3R的点图来跟踪和映射的单相系统,并被扩展为环绕Pow3R的全RGB-D系统. 传感器深度在三个可分离的站点进入:调节网络的预测,确定每个点图的度量尺度,将键框几何定位在全球优化范围内. 地图始终是网络的输出,因此孔被填满并像图1(f)一样平出正版.

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Pow3R-SLAM pipeline. Pow3R-SLAM is an RGB-D SLAM system that uses sensor depth as a prior on a two-view pointmap network. The front end (1-3) runs on every frame. (1) Pow3R predicts pointmaps and confidences for the frame and its keyframe, conditioned on sensor depth and intrinsics (Sec. III-B ). (2) Each prediction is made metric against the sensor depth (Eq. 1 ). (3) The frame is tracked in 𝐒𝐢𝐦 ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathbf{Sim}(3) and may become a keyframe (Secs. III-C – III-D ). The backend (4, 5) runs on every new keyframe. (4) Loop closure on Pow3R’s encoder tokens adds edges in familiar locations, and relocalization locates frames the tracker has lost. (5) A global optimization refines every keyframe pose, with keyframe depths anchored to the sensor and confidence-calibrated edges (Sec. III-E3 , Eqs. 5 – 7 ). Blue : the sensor-depth path. Orange : optional components, including the hybrid variant, which tracks alternate frames by ICP instead of Pow3R (Sec. III-G ), and map-only keyframes (Sec. III-F ). ICP frames never become keyframes, so every keyframe comes from a Pow3R pass. Inputs and outputs: TUM fr1/desk .
blocks.zh: 图2:Pow3R-SLAM管道. Pow3R-SLAM是一个RGB-D SLAM系统,它使用传感器深度作为双视点映射网络的前身. 前端(1-3)在每个相框上运行. (1)Pow3R预测了以传感器深度和内在条件(Sec. III-B.)为条件的帧及其键框的指向和置信度. (2) 每项预测都是针对传感器深度(Eq. 1.)作出的。 (3) 车架在Sim QQ (3)\mathbf{Sim}(3)中被跟踪,并可能成为键框(Secs. III-C-III-D). 后端(4,5)运行在每个新的键框上. (4)Pow3R编码器符号上循环关闭会增加熟悉位置的边缘,并重新定位跟踪器丢失的帧. (5) 全球优化完善了每个关键框架,将关键框架的深度固定在传感器上并调整了置信度(Sec. III-E3, Eqs. 5 – 7)。 蓝:感应深度路径. 橙色:可选组件,包括混合变体,该变体通过ICP来跟踪替代帧,而不是Pow3R(Sec. III-G),和只地图键帧(Sec. III-F.). ICP帧从未成为密钥帧,所以每个密钥帧都出自Pow3R传出. 投入和产出:TUM fr1/桌面。

blocks.en: Pow3R-SLAM adopts MASt3R-SLAM’s projective matching and second-order backend formulation, adapted to new inputs. Since Pow3R has no matching head, loop retrieval and per-correspondence confidence are rebuilt from its encoder tokens and confidence head, and map-only keyframes densify the map. A hybrid variant tracks alternate frames by iterative closest point (ICP) on the sensor depth, halving the network cost.
blocks.zh: Pow3R-SLAM采用MAST3R-SLAM的投影相配和二等后端配方,并适应了新的输入. 由于Pow3R没有匹配的头,循环回取和每对接的自信从它的编码符和信任头被重建出,而只使用地图的密钥框将地图密度化. 一个混合变体在传感器深度上通过迭接最近点(ICP)来跟踪相交帧,将网络成本减半.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: • To the best of our knowledge, the first RGB-D SLAM system in which sensor depth is a prior on a two-view pointmap network, entering at three separable sites. • Loop retrieval and per-correspondence confidence rebuilt from Pow3R’s encoder and confidence head, plus map-only keyframes that densify the map, and a hybrid ICP front end mode. • Evaluation on four benchmarks against MASt3R-SLAM and ORB-SLAM3 on accuracy, reconstruction, runtime, per-site ablations, and sensitivity to depth quality.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是: 就我们所知,第一个RGB-D SLAM系统,其中传感器深度在双视点图网络上是先入后出,进入三个可分离站点. 由Pow3R的编码器和置信头重建循环检索和每声回信,加上能放大地图的只显示地图的密钥框架,以及混合式比较方案前端模式。 • 对照MAst3R-SLAM和ORB-SLAM3,评价关于准确性、重建、运行时间、每个地点的堆放以及对深度质量的敏感性的四个基准。

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, the first RGB-D SLAM system in which sensor depth is a prior on a two-view pointmap network, entering at three separable sites.
blocks.zh: 就我们所知,第一个RGB-D SLAM系统,其中传感器深度在双视点图网络上是先入后出,进入三个可分离站点.

blocks.en: Loop retrieval and per-correspondence confidence rebuilt from Pow3R’s encoder and confidence head, plus map-only keyframes that densify the map, and a hybrid ICP front end mode.
blocks.zh: 从Pow3R的编码器和置信头重建了循环回取和每声回取信心,加上能放大地图的仅地图密钥框架,以及混合的ICP前端模式.

blocks.en: Evaluation on four benchmarks against MASt3R-SLAM and ORB-SLAM3 on accuracy, reconstruction, runtime, per-site ablations, and sensitivity to depth quality.
blocks.zh: 对照MAST3R-SLAM和ORB-SLAM3,对关于准确性、重建、运行时间、每地堆放以及对深度质量的敏感性的四项基准进行评价。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Monocular SLAM uses RGB data from a single source as input to the system. Feature-based systems such as ORB-SLAM [ 8 ] estimate poses from sparse feature correspondences across views. Dense monocular SLAM algorithms such as DTAM [ 9 ] use the entire image to create a dense model of the scene. These methods are determined only up to a similarity transform, leaving metric scale unknown.
blocks.zh: Monocular SLAM使用单一来源的RGB数据作为系统输入. 基于地物的系统,如ORB-SLAM[8]估计,来自不同观点的稀有地物对应. DTAM[9]等Dense单相机 SLAM算法使用整个图像来创建一个密集的场景模型. 这些方法只确定为相似性转变,使尺度不明。

blocks.en: RGB-D SLAM systems add a depth sensor to the camera, or use depth alone. KinectFusion [ 1 ] fuses depth into a truncated signed distance field and tracks against it. ElasticFusion [ 2 ] uses both RGB and depth images to jointly minimize photometric and geometric pose errors for tracking. ORB-SLAM2 [ 10 ] extends ORB-SLAM’s pipeline to depth, and ORB-SLAM3 [ 11 ] adds inertial measurement unit (IMU) data and multi-map support. More modern systems such as DROID-SLAM [ 12 ] pair optical flow estimation with bundle adjustment to jointly optimize pose and dense per-pixel depth. Neural map representations have recently been popularized, with the map stored as a network or optimizable set of primitives. iMAP [ 13 ] and NICE-SLAM [ 14 ] optimize implicit fields against depth, and GS-SLAM [ 15 ] optimizes a scene of 3D Gaussians, at a cost in frame rate. All of these works consume depth as geometry to fuse, or use it as a supervision target.
blocks.zh: RGB-D SLAM系统在相机上添加了深度传感器,或者单独使用深度. KinectFusion [1] 将深度导出到一个被截断的签名距离场并与之相对的轨道. 弹性Fusion [2] 使用RGB和深度图像共同将光度和几何构成跟踪错误最小化. ORB-SLAM2 [10]将ORB-SLAM的管线延伸至深度,而ORB-SLAM3 [11] 增加了惯性测量单元(IMU)数据和多映射支持. DROID-SLAM等更现代的系统[12]配对光学流估计并进行捆绑调整,以联合优化姿势和密度的每像素深度. 神经地图的表达方式最近被普及,所储存的地图作为网络或可选择的一组原始人. iMAP [13]和NICE-SLAM [14] 优化了针对深度的隐含字段,而GS-SLAM [15] 优化了由3D高斯人组成的场景,按帧率计算成本. 所有这些工程都消耗了几何深度作为引信,或将其作为监督目标。

blocks.en: A recent class of ViTs called two-view 3D reconstruction priors takes two images and outputs dense aligned 3D point clouds. These common-frame point clouds can be used to recover camera pose (such as in DUSt3R [ 4 ] ). MASt3R [ 5 ] , a successor work, added per-pixel features for alignment, which improved pose recovery. Pow3R [ 6 ] , a further successor, accepts any subset of depth, camera intrinsics, and relative pose, as optional inputs, which further improves the resulting point cloud. Extending this beyond pairs, feed-forward scene models take all views at once, such as VGGT [ 16 ] , which predicts poses and depth for a whole set of frames.
blocks.zh: 最近称为"双视三维重建前作"的ViT类,取出两个图像并输出密密的相通三维点云. 这些共同框架点云可以被用来取回相机外观(如DUST3R [4]. MASt3R [5]),是后继作品,为对接增加了每像素特性,从而改进了回放. Pow3R [6],又一个后继者,接受任何子集的深度,相机内在,和相对的外形,作为可选输入,这进一步改善了由此产生的点云. 将此延伸出对等之外,向后传输的场景模型会同时取出所有视图,例如VGGT [16],它预测了一组帧的姿势和深度.

blocks.en: Recent SLAM with reconstruction priors uses either two-view or scene prior models to track and map. MASt3R-SLAM [ 7 ] uses MASt3R for real-time tracking and mapping by optimizing projective matches, with a Sim (3) pose graph and an aggregated selective match kernel (ASMK) [ 17 ] retrieval, and is the system we extend in this work. Scene-prior systems include VGGT-SLAM [ 18 ] , which incrementally aligns VGGT submaps, and SLAM3R [ 19 ] , which fuses local reconstructions into a global scene. However, to the best of our knowledge, no reconstruction-prior-based SLAM works have investigated how depth might be used as an input.
blocks.zh: 最近带有重建前身的 SLAM 使用了双视图或场景前期模型来跟踪和映射. MASt3R-SLAM [7]通过优化投影匹配,将MASt3R用于实时跟踪和映射,并配有Sim (3)平面图和集合选择性匹配内核(ASMK)[17]检索,是我们在这项工作中扩展的系统. 场景先行系统包括VGGT-SLAM [18],它递增地将VGGT子映像对接;而SLAM3R [19],它将局部重建融合到全球场景. 然而,据我们所知,没有任何以重建为主的SLAM作品调查如何将深度用作投入。

blocks.en: III Methods
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: Fig. 2 displays the method overview, highlighting how Pow3R-SLAM works, and where both depth and the ICP hybrid approach play a role in the system.
blocks.zh: 图2显示了方法概述,突出了Pow3R-SLAM如何工作,以及深度和比较方案混合方法在系统中扮演的角色。

blocks.en: III-A Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 三-A 初步情况

blocks.en: Throughout the text, we adopt the conventions of MASt3R-SLAM [ 7 ] . Given two views i , j i,j , Pow3R [ 6 ] defines a network ℱ \mathcal{F} that takes an image pair ℐ i , ℐ j ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 \mathcal{I}^{i},\mathcal{I}^{j}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} and outputs pointmaps 𝐗 i i , 𝐗 i j , 𝐗 j j \mathbf{X}^{i}_{i},\mathbf{X}^{j}_{i},\mathbf{X}^{j}_{j} (where 𝐗 i j \mathbf{X}^{j}_{i} denotes the pointmap of image ℐ j \mathcal{I}^{j} in the coordinate system of the camera from view i i ) and their associated confidences 𝐂 i i , 𝐂 i j , 𝐂 j j \mathbf{C}^{i}_{i},\mathbf{C}^{j}_{i},\mathbf{C}^{j}_{j} . Pow3R can optionally take a subset of auxiliary information Ω ⊆ { 𝐙 i , 𝐙 j , 𝐊 i , 𝐊 j , 𝐏 i ​ j } \Omega\subseteq\{\mathbf{Z}^{i},\mathbf{Z}^{j},\mathbf{K}^{i},\mathbf{K}^{j},\mathbf{P}_{ij}\} , including depthmaps 𝐙 i , 𝐙 j ∈ ℝ H × W × 1 \mathbf{Z}^{i},\mathbf{Z}^{j}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 1} (called 𝐃 \mathbf{D} in [ 6 ] ) with their validity masks 𝐌 i , 𝐌 j ∈ { 0 , 1 } H × W \mathbf{M}^{i},\mathbf{M}^{j}\in\{0,1\}^{H\times W} , which accompany a depth map rather than being a prior of their own and indicate pixels with valid depth, camera intrinsics 𝐊 i , 𝐊 j ∈ ℝ 3 × 3 \mathbf{K}^{i},\mathbf{K}^{j}\in\mathbb{R}^{3\times 3} , and relative pose 𝐏 i ​ j ∈ ℝ 4 × 4 \mathbf{P}_{ij}\in\mathbb{R}^{4\times 4} . We write a forward pass with priors Ω \Omega as ℱ P ​ ( ℐ i , ℐ j , Ω ) \mathcal{F}_{P}(\mathcal{I}^{i},\mathcal{I}^{j},\Omega) , outputting ( 𝐗 i i , 𝐂 i i ) , ( 𝐗 i j , 𝐂 i j ) , ( 𝐗 j j , 𝐂 j j ) (\mathbf{X}^{i}_{i},\mathbf{C}^{i}_{i}),(\mathbf{X}^{j}_{i},\mathbf{C}^{j}_{i}),(\mathbf{X}^{j}_{j},\mathbf{C}^{j}_{j}) . As Pow3R-SLAM is an RGB-D approach, we assume that 𝐙 i , 𝐙 j \mathbf{Z}^{i},\mathbf{Z}^{j} are always available. 𝐏 i ​ j \mathbf{P}_{ij} is what we solve for and is never supplied, so Ω = ( 𝐙 i , 𝐙 j , 𝐊 ) \Omega=(\mathbf{Z}^{i},\mathbf{Z}^{j},\mathbf{K}) throughout this work. blocks.zh: 四. 结果

blocks.en: We evaluate localization on TUM RGB-D [ 3 ] , 7-Scenes [ 23 ] , Replica (synthetic) [ 24 ] , and ETH3D-SLAM [ 25 ] , and geometry on 7-Scenes and Replica, which have ground-truth geometry.

blocks.en:
7-Scenes provides its Kinect colour and depth images unregistered, with only the depth camera’s intrinsics, which misplaces the edges between depth and colour pixels by 20–40 px. For every system that uses depth, we therefore resample each colour image into the depth camera through the depth image. To calibrate, we take the colour focal length and radial distortion (from COLMAP [ 26 ] self-calibration of the colour images) and the 2.7 cm baseline and principal point from depth-colour edge alignment. One calibration is shared by all scenes, and neither step uses ground truth or trajectory error. The fitting corpus of ϕ \phi (Sec. blocks.en: IV-B Geometry Evaluation

blocks.en: We evaluate the exported maps against reference clouds back-projected from every 20th ground-truth depth frame (culled at 4 m, 8 m on Replica), after Sim (3) alignment of the keyframe trajectory, with the estimate thresholded at 𝐂 > 1.5 \mathbf{C}>1.5 and both clouds subsampled to 200k points. We report accuracy (mean estimate-to-reference distance), completion (the reverse), Chamfer (their average), as well as Chamfer RMSE. As noted in the supplementary materials of MASt3R-SLAM [ 7 ] , mean Chamfer does not significantly penalize incorrect points, and as our maps cover more of the scene thanks to the map-only keyframes (11.9 M vs. 2.7 M points before subsampling, over the 15 map-scored scenes), RMSE Chamfer provides a fairer comparison. Table III gives the results over 7-Scenes and Replica between MASt3R- and Pow3R-SLAM. Pow3R-SLAM has better quality mapping versus MASt3R-SLAM on both 7-Scenes and (especially) Replica, with Chamfer RMSEs of 0.058 against 0.085 on 7-Scenes, and 0.027 against 0.056 on Replica, and both accuracy and completion improve on both datasets. Over the 15 scenes, mean Chamfer is 3.1 against 4.3 cm (30% lower), and RMSE Chamfer 4.1 against 6.9 cm (40% lower). Providing 7-Scenes’ registered images to MASt3R-SLAM improved its 7-Scenes mean Chamfer from 6.7 cm, to 5.5 cm. Fig. 3 shows three scenes qualitatively.

blocks.en: IV-C Runtime
blocks.zh: 运行时间

blocks.en:
We also analyze runtime (bottom rows of Table II ). Compared to MASt3R-SLAM, which on the cross-dataset panel of all 24 scenes finishes in 1443 seconds with a mean FPS of 14.0, Pow3R-SLAM in its regular mode takes 903 seconds ( 1.6 × 1.6\times faster), averaging 18.6 FPS, and its hybrid mode takes only 698 seconds ( 2.1 × 2.1\times faster), averaging 25.3 FPS. At the full frame rate (full) the ratios are 1.5 × 1.5\times and 2.1 × 2.1\times . The CPU-only ORB-SLAM3 (a sparse tracker with no network pass) takes 371 seconds, running at 51 FPS, for reference. On 7-Scenes, Pow3R-SLAM times include the colour registration.
Pow3R has no matching head, so MASt3R-SLAM’s per-frame descriptor refinement is absent. The hybrid variant also skips the network pass on every 2nd frame, which occupies 2/3 of the tracker’s time. Pow3R also has fewer parameters than MASt3R (556 M vs. 695 M), yet its network pass takes about as long (41 vs. 44 ms per frame).

blocks.en: IV-D Ablations
blocks.zh: 四-D 差额

blocks.en:
To study the effects of each of Pow3R-SLAM’s components, Table IV switches them on one at a time.
The single most impactful change is the introduction of priors to Pow3R, which takes the mean ATE from 0.083 m (against MASt3R-SLAM’s 0.030 m) to 0.032 m (L1 to L3). It is the depth conditioning (not intrinsics) that plays the larger role (L2 vs. L3), and removing it (L6) regresses 20/23 scenes it still completes, while fr1/rpy diverges. Scale lowers the Sim (3) ATE further (0.032 to 0.026 m) and cuts the unscaled SE (3) error from 0.364 to 0.034 m and the map Chamfer distance from 6.6 to 3.1 cm. The anchor is neutral on this panel (at most 4.9 mm of Sim (3) ATE on any scene). Map-only keyframes keep trajectories identical while improving the Chamfer distance (3.27 to 3.05 cm with 4.4 × 4.4\times the points). Hybrid mode gives comparable performance to the default mode, with a better median ATE, though scored per frame it is slightly worse (Sec. IV-A ).

blocks.en: V Limitations
blocks.zh: 五 限制

blocks.en: While the depth prior improves the prediction where sensor depth has holes, makes it metric, and improves aggregate results, it does not make the estimators more robust. Scenes for which Pow3R-SLAM is worse than MASt3R-SLAM include stairs in 7-Scenes (Fig. 4 ), and planar_3 , sofa_2 , and repetitive in ETH3D-SLAM. We hypothesize that repeating, self-similar structures cause these failures, as when Pow3R predicts a complete and confident geometry, the matching can find incorrect but mutually consistent correspondences that pull the backend to a wrong solution.
blocks.zh: 虽然先前的深度可以改善传感器深度有孔的预测,使其具有度量性,并改进了总结果,但并不能使估计器更坚固. Pow3R-SLAM比MAST3R-SLAM更糟糕的场景包括:7-Scenes(图4)的楼梯和planar_3,sofa_2,以及ETH3D-SLAM的重复. 我们假设重复自相仿的结构会导致这些失败,因为当Pow3R预测一个完整而自信的几何时,匹配可以找到不正确但相互一致的对应,将后端拉入错误的解决方案.

blocks.en: VI Conclusions
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en: We presented Pow3R-SLAM, an RGB-D SLAM system that combines measured depth with learned two-view reconstruction to produce metric trajectories and dense maps. Depth conditions network predictions, sets pointmap scale, and anchors keyframe geometry during global optimization. Across 24 sequences from TUM, 7-Scenes, and Replica, Pow3R-SLAM runs 1.6 × 1.6\times faster than MASt3R-SLAM, with 15 % 15\% lower mean keyframe trajectory error and 3.1 × 3.1\times lower per-frame trajectory error without scale alignment. Its maps are denser, and achieve 30 % 30\% lower Chamfer distance on 7-Scenes and Replica. The hybrid ICP variant further improves runtime, reaching 25.3 FPS and a 2.1 × 2.1\times speedup over MASt3R-SLAM.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了Pow3R-SLAM,这是一个RGB-D SLAM系统,该系统将测量深度与所学的双视重建相结合,生成了公尺轨迹和稠密地图. 深度条件网络预测,设定点映射尺度,并在全球优化期间锁定键框几何. 在TUM,7-Scens,和Replica的24个序列中,Pow3R-SLAM的运行速度快于MAST3R-SLAM的1.6×1.6\时,平均键帧轨迹误差为15%×15%;每帧轨迹误差为3.1×3.1\时,没有尺度对齐. 它的地图更密集,在7-相机和复制机上实现30%的相距更低. 混合式国际比较方案变体进一步改善了运行时间,达到25.3个FPS,比MAst3R-SLAM加快了2.1× 2.1.

blocks.en: Ablations identify depth conditioning as the main source of accuracy gains and scaling as essential for metric output. Conditioning remains effective with only 3 % 3\% of depth pixels supplied to the network, showing that sparse measurements can still guide dense reconstruction. Depth noise and self-similar scenes remain challenging. Future work will investigate consistency-aware confidence gating, training with realistic sensor noise, and multi-view reconstruction priors. These results establish depth-conditioned pointmaps as a practical basis for real-time SLAM, combining improved trajectory accuracy and map completeness with lower runtime.
blocks.zh: 减值将深度调节确定为准确度提高的主要来源,而缩放则是衡量产出的关键。 附加条件仍然有效,只有3%的深度像素提供给网络,这表明稀有的测量仍能引导密集重建. 深度噪音和自相类似的场景仍然具有挑战性. 今后的工作将调查对一致性的认识 -- -- 信心的取景、以现实感应噪音进行的培训以及多视图重建的前身。 这些结果确立了有深度条件的点图,作为实时SLAM的实用基础,将提高的轨迹精度和地图完整性与较低的运行时间结合起来.
